title: Check the flag-0 restore recipe against its frame operator
body:
## Summary
- Event 5807 returns `Y34` from the full frame to its rank-8 frame. Target 34's stored restore recipe is rank 1 and has 9 gates.
- The operator of the swapped physical frames has 21 gates. The two operators have the same signed Pauli tableau and the same exact global phase.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The source read at event 5759 still has no owner in this reading.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/p104-tail-flag0-restore/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/p104-tail-flag0-restore/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-tail-flag0-restore`
- [ ] Confirm the registered replay on the maintainer's Python 3.12 checkout
